gloss: to apply; to be applicable; to fall under; to qualify

definitions.gloss: to apply; to be applicable; to fall under; to qualify
definitions.explanation: To meet the relevant criteria or conditions; to be included in a certain category or classification. Common in formal, legal, and administrative contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{該当|がいとう}する⟦{方|かた}→方：10665_kata⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧お⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出る：10465_moushideru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Those who meet the conditions, please come forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{以下|いか}→以下：01294_ika⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いずれか→いずれか：22057_izureka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{該当|がいとう}する⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、ご⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please contact us if any of the following applies.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{我々|われわれ}→我々：03795_wareware⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧しない⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}した→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: We determined that this regulation does not apply to us.

notes:
COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{該当|がいとう}する: to fall under ~; to apply to ~
- 〜⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{該当|がいとう}する: ~ applies/qualifies
- ⟦{該当|がいとう}→該当：14177_gaitou⟧しない: not applicable; does not apply
- {該当|がいとう}する⟦{場合|ばあい}→場合：01704_baai⟧: when applicable; if this applies

Frequently seen on official forms, regulations, and notices. Often appears as 「{該当|がいとう}する⟦{項目|こうもく}→項目：04150_koumoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{丸|まる}→丸：02167_maru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧」 (Please circle the applicable item).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{当|あ}てはまる→当てはまる：10212_atehamaru⟧: to apply; to fit — more everyday; used for general matching
- ⟦{適用|てきよう}する→適用する：21739_tekiyousuru⟧: to apply (a rule, law, etc.) — used when actively applying something
